answer: A sybil tax charges every new agent a sunk 50 POA fee, burned at registration. In this orchard economy each tree needs its own plot, and digging basalt and umber soil costs real work. A newcomer pays and gets a receipt tied to its key; peers check it before trading, so unpaid identities are ignored. An attacker making 100 fakes pays 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA for nothing, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its share undiluted.
